title: JustAI Stream Relay
description: Health, traffic and abuse metrics of the JustAI livestream relay (scraped by Alloy).

list.name: Source down
list.expr: relay_upstream_up{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"} == 0 and relay_upstream_up{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"} offset 1m == 1

panels.title: Sources streaming
panels.description: Share of configured sources that currently deliver audio (relay_upstream_up).

targets.expr: sum(relay_upstream_up{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}) / count(relay_upstream_up{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"})

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the relay process started. Resets show restarts.

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: All HTTP requests handled by the relay.

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a server error (5xx), incl. 503 busy.

panels.title: Failed auth / s
panels.description: 401 and 429 responses: wrong token or throttled bots.

panels.title: Connections shed
panels.description: Connections closed at accept because a limit was reached (selected range).

panels.title: In-flight requests
panels.description: Authenticated requests currently holding one of the 32 slots (503 busy above 32).

panels.title: Source state
panels.description: Per source: Streaming while audio is flowing, Down while the upstream session is not producing segments.

panels.title: Time since last segment
panels.description: Age of the newest 5s segment per source. Green < 15s, orange 15-30s, red > 30s (matches the RelayUpstreamStale alert).

panels.title: Segment freshness
panels.description: Stale if at least one moment within the cell had no segment newer than 30s, otherwise Fresh. The query is aggregated per cell, so short gaps stay visible at any zoom level.

panels.title: Segments per minute
panels.description: Produced 5-second segments per minute. A healthy source delivers 12.

panels.title: Upstream session endings
panels.description: Why upstream capture sessions ended: eof (stream closed), rejected (not audio/mpeg or redirect), idle_timeout, error. Frequent bars mean a flapping source.

panels.title: Sources
panels.description: Current state per source. Session length counts since the current upstream session began producing audio.

targets.expr: max by (source) ((time() - relay_upstream_session_start_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}) and on(job, instance, source) (relay_upstream_up{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"} == 1))

panels.title: Requests by status code
panels.description: HTTP requests per second by response code. 401/429 are failed-auth or throttled clients; 5xx are server errors.

panels.title: Requests by source and endpoint
panels.description: Manifest and segment polling per source, plus metrics/health/other. Authenticated sources: expect about one segment request per 5s per client.

panels.title: Request duration distribution
panels.description: Heatmap of request durations from the histogram buckets (all endpoints).

panels.title: Request duration quantiles
panels.description: p50 / p95 / p99 across all endpoints.

panels.title: Egress bandwidth
panels.description: Response body bytes per second per source (segments are about 160 KB each).

panels.title: In-flight requests
panels.description: Concurrent authenticated requests. The relay answers 503 busy above 32.

panels.title: Failed authentication
panels.description: Requests with a wrong or missing token (401) and throttled clients (429). Spikes indicate scanners or a misconfigured token.

panels.title: Connections shed
panels.description: Connections closed at accept: total = global cap reached, per_ip = single client above its cap.
